Answer: B
Reason: Figure 1 shows bilateral alveolar infiltrates, and Figure 3 demonstrates progression to dense consolidation predominantly in the left lung; this pattern of worsening unilateral/bilateral opacities is consistent with diffuse alveolar damage and microbleeds seen in Exercise-Induced Pulmonary Hemorrhage (EIPH), whereas pneumonia typically resolves and cardiogenic edema would not present with such focal progressive consolidation.
